Mia (Marketing): final preflight for tomorrow's 10:00am session — quick checklist pls :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Raj (Events Ops): go ahead — I'll run greenroom 9:15-9:50 and do audio checks. who has host?
Mia (Marketing): Sam will be host + recorder. Sam (Media Ops): confirmed, I'll start local recording as backup. cloud record goes to the org account.
Taylor (Product Marketing): landing page is live: https://redwood.example/events/launch-deep-dive — CTA points to hubspot form. can someone confirm hidden field for "source=benchmark-email"?
Leo (Growth): confirmed mapping in HubSpot zap. snippet: ```hubspot_field: source -> "benchmark-email"; form_id: 9843```
Ava (Content): captions + SRT required. Sam, can you also export captions and drop in Google Drive under /events/launch/recordings?
Sam (Media Ops): yep. will export SRT and speaker labels. local filename convention: redwood-2026-03-24-launch-10am.mp4
Raj (Events Ops): Zoom settings I toggled: Waiting Room OFF, Join before host OFF, Mute participants on entry ON, Record active speaker + gallery. enable 'Allow participants to unmute' for panelists only.
Mia (Marketing): also: please enable "Only authenticated users can join" = OFF (we expect external attendees). DM if security concerns.
zoombot: Recording started by Sam at 2026-03-24 09:16:12 UTC (simulated message)
Taylor (Product Marketing): has anyone built the post-event nurture? I'm planning a two-step: day0 thank-you + day2 clip + day7 benchmark highlights. Leo, can you route HOT leads to SDR queue?
Leo (Growth): yep — HubSpot workflow created. criteria: attended >= 10 mins OR watched clip > 50%. leads tagged "event:launch-deep-dive" and routed to @SDR-Team.
Ava (Content): for the clip, can we grab 90s intro + 60s benchmark slide? Sam, please save two clips with captions burned in.
Sam (Media Ops): will do. export names: launch_intro_90s.mp4, benchmark_slide_60s.mp4. uploading to Drive at end of day.
Raj (Events Ops): contingency: if Zoom cloud fails, switch to local RTMP from OBS to backup RTMP server (ops: rtmp://backup.redwood.int/live). Sam has creds.
Mia (Marketing): great. last items: social snippets (Ava), landing page post-attendee message (Taylor), analytics tag (Leo). Everyone ok? :thumbsup:
Taylor (Product Marketing): ok from PM side. I'll draft attendee email now and post in #marketing-drafts.
Leo (Growth): running ads paused until recording confirmed. will unpause 15m after go-live if recording active.
Ava (Content): creating three captions styles (burned-in, sidecar SRT, transcript). will upload as separate assets.
Sam (Media Ops): recording + captions checklist done. will ping when uploads complete.
Mia (Marketing): thanks all — we'll reconvene in #marketing 09:45 for greenroom join link. :star:
Raj (Events Ops): noted. closing thread, will post final join link 09:30.
